title: Poll-based ingestion, Courier originates all sends
body: Courier polls the LMS Aurora read replica (lms_ro) for state and originates all sends itself. It does not depend on an LMS push or event pipeline for sending.

attributes.statement: Courier polls the LMS Aurora read replica (lms_ro) for state and originates all sends itself. It does not depend on an LMS push or event pipeline for sending.
attributes.rationale: The fleet is heterogeneous, with both Laravel and WordPress brands. A push-relay model requiring a distributable Laravel package could never cover the WordPress brands, forcing separate integrations or continued dependence on Brevo for non-Laravel brands.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Push/relay model using a Beacon package installed in each sending brand
alternatives_rejected.reason: Structurally incapable of covering non-Laravel brands across the fleet.
